owner_post_only_center_shift_screen.reason: For the fixed opposed AB205 pattern, 38.1 mm is only a necessary post-only shift for one coincident factory pair: its cross-pair is then 9.525 mm apart. All four distinct header axes first meet the conditional 3D same-row screen at 85.725 mm shift, ignoring other fit. A protected kerf-right kicker screw axis center reaches the post inner edge by 19.05 mm; even the weaker 38.1-mm necessary condition conflicts. The historical 4.1402-mm occupied-axis envelope is not a Hillman bore. This is not a rejection of other factory hole patterns or a complete kicker support verdict.

br904_fixed_center_pose_screen.half_inch_reason: At assumed 34.5-mm bend-to-near-hole offset, 1/2-inch bolt has -0.207-mm ray-only search margin after nominal factory-hole radial play. Moving to the 34.659-mm threshold leaves only about 0.058 mm further lateral allowance under the conditional 4D row screen, before other errors. This is not a formal NDS oblique-end rejection.
br904_fixed_center_pose_screen.seven_sixteenths_reason: The nominal 9/16-inch factory hole is 1/8 inch larger than a 7/16-inch bolt, exceeding the ordinary 2024 NDS 12.1.3.2 maximum 1/16-inch oversize; its wider geometric band is a diagnostic, not an installable schedule.

ordinary_stock_scope_contingency.reason: V4 permits plain timber overlaps and bolted timber cleats but still excludes cutting and drilling ordinary steel stock into a custom connector. The earlier factory-only reason is historical.

bounded_factory_material_follow_up.checked_2026_09_19: ABB Superstrut ZAB205EG-10 remains an exact Home Depot factory-made four-hole retail model with a nominal 1/4-inch plate and nominal hole centers. bounded_factory_material_follow_up.orientation_caution: The 1-5/8-inch plate width does not by itself rule out a 1-1/2-inch-thick 2x6: in the center trial the plate width lies along the 5-1/2-inch broad face, not across the 1-1/2-inch thickness. Judge each installed orientation against its actual CAD faces and holes.
